what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Niger by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 392474 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 459585.
Refugees from Niger live mainly in Mali and Nigeria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Niger from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government with JNIM from 2021 to 2025, and an earlier one with the MNJ in 2007 and 2008.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Niger in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 11000 in 2009 to 392474 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2023.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 67111 fewer internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Niger people moved to.
